implementation_review.recovery: Definite guard refusal takes existing no-byte rejection path: no venue order ID, terminal local intent, reservation released; journal reflects refusal; account_at cleared and a new complete account sync required before a later fresh lock with a different ID. Restart case verifies restored refusal remains terminal and unreserved.
